The fix for TRUNK-6796 is pull request #6537 in openmrs-core, "Fix NPE whe death date is null when merging patients," merged on 2026-10-07 as commit `21ea98bd`. It changed one line in `PersonMergeLogData.computeHashValue()`: the prior-date-of-death ternary tested `getPriorDateOfBirth()` instead of `getPriorDateOfDeath()`. The ternary now guards on `getPriorDateOfDeath()`, so a null prior date of death no longer reaches `.toString()`. The same PR adds a regression test, `computeHashValue_shouldNotThrowExceptionWhenPriorDateOfDeathIsNull`.

Evidence, best first:

1. The fixed line at the merge commit: `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/person/PersonMergeLogData.java:445`. The diff against the parent shows line 445 changed from `getPriorDateOfBirth() != null` to `getPriorDateOfDeath() != null`.
2. The method containing the fix: `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/person/PersonMergeLogData.java:392-448`.
3. The sibling line that was already correct: `openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/person/PersonMergeLogData.java:444`.
4. The regression test added by the PR: `openmrs-core/api/src/test/java/org/openmrs/person/PersonMergeLogDataTest.java:21-26`.
5. PR #6537 metadata: title, body, linked ticket, merge commit, and the two changed files (one line in the main class, 27 lines of test added). Falkon's ticket lookup links it to TRUNK-6796 through the ticket pattern.
6. Other callers of `computeHashValue()` in `openmrs-core/api/src/test/java/org/openmrs/api/PersonServiceTest.java:1510-1514`. They are related but did not change in the fix.
